command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: write sudoers snippet =="
cat > /tmp/sudo-command-logging <<'EOF'
Defaults !syslog
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults log_year
Defaults log_host
EOF

echo "== STEP 2: validate syntax =="
sudo -n visudo -cf /tmp/sudo-command-logging

echo "== STEP 3: install into /etc/sudoers.d =="
sudo -n install -m 0440 -o root -g root /tmp/sudo-command-logging /etc/sudoers.d/sudo-command-logging
rm -f /tmp/sudo-command-logging

echo "== STEP 4: full sudoers syntax check (includes new file) =="
sudo -n visudo -c

echo "== STEP 5: pre-create dedicated log file with tight perms =="
sudo -n install -m 0600 -o root -g root /dev/null /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== STEP 6: capture baseline sizes of general logs =="
sudo -n wc -l /var/log/secure /var/log/messages
sudo -n journalctl --no-pager -n 0 2>/dev/null; date +%s > /tmp/mark_epoch

echo "== STEP 7: generate a marked sudo command to test logging =="
sudo -n /bin/true
sudo -n /usr/bin/id -u
MARKER="sudo-log-test-marker-$$"
sudo -n /bin/echo "$MARKER"

echo "== STEP 8: verify dedicated log file captured it, with user+timestamp =="
sudo -n cat /var/log/sudo-commands.log

echo "== STEP 9: verify general system log did NOT get new sudo COMMAND entries =="
sudo -n tail -5 /var/log/secure
echo "-- messages tail --"
sudo -n tail -5 /var/log/messages
echo "-- grep marker in secure/messages (expect nothing) --"
sudo -n grep -F "$MARKER" /var/log/secure /var/log/messages || echo "OK: marker absent from general logs"
echo "-- grep marker in journal (expect nothing new from sudo) --"
sudo -n journalctl -q --no-pager | grep -F "$MARKER" || echo "OK: marker absent from journal"

echo "== STEP 10: file perms on dedicated log =="
sudo -n ls -la /var/log/sudo-commands.log /etc/sudoers.d/sudo-command-logging
